text: {"lessons":["Repeatedly selling Stock B, D, and E for gains and later buying back shares shows that locking in small wins can leave me chasing prices; I should decide position sizes from my plan, not the pleasure of realizing gains.","My account’s gains and losses across periods are noisy, and recent moves do not forecast what comes next; I should avoid reacting to short-term swings alone.","Before each trade, I should weigh the stock’s role, portfolio risk, and available cash rather than treating each holding as a separate win-or-loss account."]}
